notes.title: Zcrew Halloween Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Features
●	Introducing challenge mode to the map.
●	Introducing the Monster Invasion challenge: Resist the invasion from waves of monsters. The longer you stand, the better reward you will receive. The challenge will fail if the number of monsters reaches a certain level.
●	Introducing the Turret Defense challenge： You must stop monsters from entering beyond the red line. Killing the monsters will reward you with points which can be used to exchange defense gears. Players cannot use weapons/skills in this challenge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/0c8d959cdd45952ad47096c7d41845cfb0018624.gif
●	Introducing the Infinite Challenge mode： The monsters will get stronger as time progresses. The longer you survive, the more chance you have to get automatic weapons and better rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/082907ae2cc577c525feeb670f17990f73069660.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/0bf607add6cc7bdc47131d107dfdaff0900fc80e.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/0bec648f1e0c3cd4298beb49817b40c42df16ea1.gif
Optimization
●	Increased damage and attack speed of max-level automatic weapons.
●	Added automatic weapon chest in the Void Realm
●	Removed weapon restrictions in the Void Realm
Other Changes
●	Added one headpiece for each class
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/e2494fb208b8a07383064f28ad35d251136f19ab.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/483f39e095239515928b4ee9837dcce7d97c2913.png
●	Added Halloween decorations in the base.

notes.title: October Update - Controller Support now available!
notes.notes:
ZCrew October Patch Notes
Happy Halloween!

We have a bit of a smaller patch this month, but didn't want to miss out on the Halloween fun and added some fun Halloween decor around the base!

We're also happy to announce that Controller support is now available!

Check out the rest of this month's update here:

New Features

 You can now enjoy the game with a game controller

 Lower Limbs: Increased damage when stamina is above 80%

Other Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/0c8188441769b29eea55ab9bdae932aff9103e25.gif

notes.title: 《Zcrew》official version is now LIVE on Steam.
notes.notes:
Dear anticipating comrades,


     Zcrew official version is now LIVE on Steam. 

    It has been almost 2 years since our early access launch, and your continuing support and suggestions are what made this official version possible. 

    More game contents are yet to come to this official version. We are developing more maps, secondary weapons, vehicles, and weapon stats to offer a much more exciting and smooth gameplay experience for everyone.

      We would like to thank you again for all the support on social media. We hope we can work together to make this game successful.

     If you have any suggestions or bugs to report, please reach out to us via discord 

    Thank you, and we look forward to fighting alongside you, my comrades.

New System

notes.notes:
《Z-Crew》9/2 Patch Notes

Patch will be released September 3rd at 12AM PDT

Optimization

 Adjusted the rewards for garrison 
 Adjusted the amount of ammos being picked up during missions. Now the amount is based on your magazine capacity. 
 Adjusted the skills/CD/HP/damage of some monsters.

BUG Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Mecha cannot get data in mission rewards UI. 
 Fixed an issue where the game can crash upon starting a mission. 

Game Experience Optimization

 Supply skill “Ammunition Supply” rework
 Optimized Supply skill “Roll”
 Adjusted Medic Skill “First Aid Kit”
 Added and adjusted a couple of sound effects
 Optimized monster spawn in some missions
 Added screen shaking effect for weapons. 
 Zombies now have more diversified models。

New Functions

 Mouse wheel can now zoom in/out screen. 


Supply Skill/Talent Changes: 

 Roll：Perform a roll and  increase movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
 Nimble：movement speed buff after performing a roll will last an additional 2 seconds. 
 Accelerate：movement speed buff after performing a roll will be 50%.
 Dodge：Roll skill CD will lower by 2 seconds after performing one. 

 Ammunition Supply：Spawns an ammunition box that replenishes 50% of the current magazine and 4% of the magazine capacity every 2 seconds within 5 meters. Lasts 10 seconds.

 Big Mac：The area in effect will increase by 2 meters.
 Enhance：Skill now will  replenish 60% of the current magazine and 6% of the magazine capacity every 2 seconds.
 Durable：Skill will now last 6 seconds. 

Medic Skill/Talent Changes

First Aid Kit：Generates a first aid kit within 5 meters, healing teammates and  dealing continuous damage to the enemies within.

 Paralyze：Slow down enemies by 50% within range.
 Focus：Increase range by 2 meters. 
Biomedical：Increase the healing effect by 20% and the continuous damage by 20%. 
 



Tell us what you think!

notes.title: 《Z-Crew》4/29 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Scheduled to go live at 12 am PDT Friday morning 4/30/21

Calling all Hunters!

We hope that you have been surviving out there in the Wastelands and teaming up with friends to bring hope back to humanity. It's been a long stretch since the initial release so we're dropping a big care package of goodies to get you fired up and slaying monsters once again.

Want to just go out there and just blow off a little steam and a few zombie heads? Infinite challenge is a new mode just for you. No missions, just survive as long as you can by killing as many as you can. 

Looking for some good loot? We've added Secret Treasure Hunt to get you searching for some awesome gear. But beware of the mines and the guards or instead of heading home with a bag full of loot, your crew will be carrying you back in a body bag.

We've also added a ton of quality of life features. New to the game? We got a tutorial to get you started. Wanna show off to friends? We've added the new combo, player title, and achievement systems for you to showcase your slaying skills. Need an extra (or easier challenge)? Feel free to set your difficulty with corresponding payouts.

All this with some new gear, optimization fixes, and even BETA controller support, we hope will add a ton of fun and replayability for all you hunters new and old alike. Please let us know what you think of the update and always "Happy Hunting!"

1. New Gameplay
Infinite Challenge

 Hunters will have to eliminate as many monsters as possible within a given time.
 Hunters will fail the challenge once the monster limit on the map is reached.
 You will get better rewards as you survive longer, including Chips that will enhance your power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/04eacfd32395f3bbce8281ac4f7b1145bdd5c7e6.gif
 
Secret Treasure Hunt

 - Pressing “3” will allow you to take out the minesweeper to sweep any mines nearby. The minefield will have a certain chance of spawning a treasure chest, which contains a very generous reward. There is also a certain chance of you disturbing the treasure guards, which can also drop generous rewards upon defeating them. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/0722771aca4326bec8a1a116475e6084493639c2.gif

2. New System
Combo System

 Consecutive attacks will now grant you a combo status, which will increase your damage as you achieve higher combo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/6f75c5a928120848711a0066373783300ce83711.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/e19e255492ebfad1cc16b37dbd1b3b409a36b1f5.gif
Controller Support (Beta)

 Players will now enter a Beginner tutorial after creating a character. The tutorial will introduce basic mechanics and worldview.

-Personal Character Information

 Hunters can now view character information of themselves and other players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/21caeca49bfec5b93b654ab704b3214b7ee0d54f.gif
-Chips

 Up to 6 chips can be inserted on weapons, which will give you bonus effects.
 
-Achievement System

 Hunters will be able to unlock achievements after satisfying certain requirements.
 Trophies can be displayed at the base.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/a4a0c86926321fe8090522f92ddf5aba2d538b19.gif
Title System

 Hunters will get titles after unlocking achievements, which can be displayed above their head.

New Mission Difficulties 

 Hunters can now choose among easy/normal/hard difficulties, which will have different drop rates.

Like Feature

 Hunters can now hit the like button for teammates once a mission is completed. 

3.Optimization

 If a hunter joins mid-game, he/she cannot get loot from previous progress.

 Walking will have lower noises than running.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/3f1c408b0c5cbb7b12ac2e9eab8f3e3434035541.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39191967/f8b659ad6690aacabd0e339d135da9ca27a0bdeb.gif
 Environmental effects have been added. E.g: lava will lower your health, swamp will lower your speed, etc.

 Monsters will become more powerful as you enter higher level missions.

 Adding player information UI (including character level/class level/power level) during mission preparation.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2/5/2021
notes.notes:
Hey there, Hunters!

We have a small update tonight with a few Quality of LIfe improvements to create a smoother experience for Hunters as we continue the mission to reclaim Earth!

Intel is key, and Dungeons now display details of material drops. Now you know exactly where to go to pick up what you need! A mission rewards UI has also been added. Review how your mission broke down, what you've gained, and pinpoint what you can do to further improve! We have also added level notifications and made it easier to invite your crew to join you on your missions! 

Most notably, we are also replacing the old Weapon Crafting system with a Weapon Growth system that we feel will be more intuitive and better fitting for the theme of the game. As highly enhanced humans in a world of rapid technological advancement, its only natural that our weapons grow with us as we hunt and conquer mission after mission. Damage numbers are also being added in game and different weapons will deal different damage to different enemies. Find the optimal combination to succeed!

Finally, we'd like to thank the Hunters who have joined our efforts in this Early Access stage. We look forward to hearing your ideas! We're still very early in the quest to save the world and you are a part of our evolution as we continue to develop the game! Please let us know how you feel about the UI, the characters, skills, and in particular, the game mechanics and controls! Of course, we need your help squashing bugs (and zombies) as well! We'll be checking out your reports on the Steam Discussions, Hunters! 

- Team ZCREW

 New weapon growth system to replace the old crafting system.
